facts.fact: Winter 计划抓到后让 Sterling 披红斗篷游街
facts.anchor: she would be paraded through town wearing it so everyone would see his prize

facts.fact: 确认她是 RRH 的瞬间，怜悯清零；悔当年未直接杀她
facts.anchor: any compassion he might’ve felt for her before was gone the moment he discovered she was Red Riding Hood

facts.fact: Winter 转向杠杆：弟弟大概率在肉店
facts.anchor: She had a brother who wasn’t at home, which meant he was likely at their meat shop

facts.fact: 肉店里认出 Nareth 是他常去的妓院保镖
facts.anchor: The brown-haired man was the bodyguard at one of the brothels Winter frequented

facts.fact: Nareth 撒盐迷眼、喊 Cyan 逃跑
facts.anchor: he withdrew his hand from his apron pocket and flung salt in Winter’s face. “Cyan, run!”

facts.fact: 毒打致 Nareth 肋骨断裂、单眼肿胀
facts.anchor: The way he clutched at his ribs, Winter was certain he’d broken a few

facts.fact: 亮红斗篷逼问时 Nareth 面露困惑，Winter 不确定真假
facts.anchor: Winter paused at the genuine confusion on Nareth’s face, but he didn’t put it past the human to be a skilled liar

facts.fact: 留话：Sterling 明早日落前到庄园自首换弟弟
facts.anchor: she’ll turn herself over to me at my manor before tomorrow’s sunset

facts.fact: 威胁 Cyan：敢动就杀你们俩
facts.anchor: If you move in the slightest, I’ll kill you both

facts.fact: 扛走 Cyan，威胁别尖叫否则狼群啃脚趾
facts.anchor: I can’t promise my pack won’t gnaw your toes off as a midnight snack
